Greetings, Agents. 


This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

The first Super Hero who has been created 
in the MARVEL Future Fight universe 
has returned with new armor! 

 

With her new Uniform and Tier-4, Captain America (Sharon Rogers) 
will never get tired of beating her enemies with her powerful Poseidon Lance.

 

Agents, check out her new skills and power
by downloading the 4/18 Patch!

 

■ 4/18 Patch Details

 

Patch Schedule: 4/19 (Wed) 3:00 (UTC+0), 4/18 (Tue) 20:00 (PDT) 

 

[4/19 (Wed) 3:10 (UTC+0), 4/18 (Tue) 20:10 (PDT) added]

The patch has been completed as of 4/19 (Wed) 3:09 (UTC+0), 4/18 (Tue) 20:09 (PDT). 

We apologize for the delay with the patch application.

Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.

 

* The patch completion time may be changed depending on the circumstances 
and the completion time will be announced once the patch has been finished.
* The patch will be applied in waves, so the application time may vary by Agent.
* The game can still be accessed during the patch.
Please restart and apply the patch for better service when the patch is complete.

 


▣ One New Uniform

 

One new Uniform, Captain America (Sharon Rogers) <Poseidon Armor>, has been added.


* The new Uniform can be purchased after the 4/18 Patch data is applied.
* The new Uniforms can be found and purchased in the Marvel Universe and the Uniform Room.
* New Uniform Skills are based on the following skill Level stats.
(Tier-4 heroes: Lv. 10, Others: Lv. 6)

 

 

 

▣ Captain America (Sharon Rogers) Tier-4


Captain America (Sharon Rogers) is now available for Tier-4 Advancement.
The defender who keeps regenerating and becoming stronger will exhaust her enemies. 
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

▣ 8-Year Anniversary Comic Card

 

A new Comic Card and a collection will be added 
in celebration of the 8-Year Anniversary of MARVEL Future Fight.


The 8-Year Anniversary Comic Card can be acquired through the event that will be held afterward.

 

* The stats of the options are based on the highest tier and quality.

* One option among the 3★ - 6★ options will be acquired randomly as an additional option.
* The probabilities of each option to be acquired are the same.

 

 

▣ 2nd Potential Level Enhance Ticket


Level 8 - 12 Potential Enhance Tickets and Level 9 - 12 Advanced Potential Enhance Tickets 
have been added so that Agents can raise the level of heroes 
who have realized their 2nd Potential consecutively from 70 to 80.
* 2nd Potential Level Enhance Tickets cannot be used on native heroes.
- The acquisition method will be announced through a separate notice.

 

 


▣ Game Error Fixes


1. The issue of the enemy being displayed in the wrong place 
at the animation that appears when beginning World Boss Ultimate: Super Giant 
and Alliance Battle Extreme: Frost Beast has been fixed.


We look forward to your active participation in the events 
that will be held to support the growth of the updated heroes.


Thank you.
